title: Northgate Optical Replacement Fitting Fee Card
content:
**Northgate Optical replacement fitting fee — accidental damage replacements.** Where the job already carries two or more remakes, no replacement fitting fee is charged, and where it carries exactly one, the replacement fitting fee is 7.50. A job carrying no remake is outside this card.

| Remakes the job already carries | Replacement fitting fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | none |
| exactly one | 7.50 |

**Counting.** The remakes counted are the remake charge entries already on the job, whatever their reason or amount; the replacement being authorized is not one of them.

### Illustrations (hypothetical jobs)

| Remake charge entries already on the job | Count | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| one non-adapt at 0.00 | 1 | 7.50 |
| one non-adapt and one prescription change | 2 | none |
| one lab defect, one non-adapt, one prescription change | 3 | none |
| none | 0 | outside this card |
